mode.title: Proxy
mode.description: Used by the built-in local server for model requests, and by the app for sign-in renewal and update checks.

fields.schemeDescription: HTTP for most proxy apps; SOCKS5 when the proxy only offers that.
fields.hostDescription: Host name or IP address of the proxy.
fields.portDescription: Clash and v2rayN usually listen on 7890 or 10809.
fields.usernameDescription: Only for proxies that require sign-in.
fields.bypassDescription: One per line, or separated by commas. Host names, *.example.com, IP addresses and ranges such as 192.168.* or 10.0.0.0/8. This computer is always reached directly.

notices.managed: Your organization manages the network proxy for this app.
notices.restart: Changes apply after the app restarts. Replies in progress on this computer will stop.
notices.systemChanged: The system proxy settings have changed since the app started. Restart to use them.
notices.pacIgnored: Your system uses an automatic configuration script (PAC), which the app cannot apply. Requests connect directly; choose Manual to use a proxy.
notices.webviewNotApplied: The app window itself keeps following the system proxy settings; this setting covers the local server and the app's own requests.

toasts.savedDescription: They apply after the app restarts.
toasts.saveFailed: Could not save the proxy settings
toasts.loadFailed: Could not read the proxy settings

errors.host: Enter a host name or IP address, without http:// or a path.
errors.bypass: "{value}" is not a host name, address or range.
errors.policy: Your organization manages the network proxy for this app.
errors.storage: The settings could not be stored: {message}
